description: This file contains template specializations and class definitions related to IListRef implementations for tensors and optional tensors in the ATen library, including unboxed, boxed, and materialized variants.

classes.name: IListRefTagImplBase<IListRefTag::Unboxed, T, ListElemT>
classes.description: Base implementation for IListRefTag for unboxed list references.

classes.name: IListRefTagImplBase<IListRefTag::Boxed, T, ListElemT>
classes.description: Base implementation for IListRefTag for boxed list references.

classes.name: IListRefTagImplBase<IListRefTag::Materialized, T, MaterializedIListRefElem<T>>
classes.description: Base implementation for IListRefTag for materialized list references.

classes.name: IListRefTagImpl<IListRefTag::Unboxed, at::Tensor>
classes.description: Specialization of IListRefTagImpl for unboxed at::Tensor.

classes.name: IListRefTagImpl<IListRefTag::Boxed, at::Tensor>
classes.description: Specialization of IListRefTagImpl for boxed at::Tensor.

classes.name: IListRefTagImpl<IListRefTag::Materialized, at::Tensor>
classes.description: Specialization of IListRefTagImpl for materialized at::Tensor.

classes.name: IListRefTagImpl<IListRefTag::Unboxed, at::OptionalTensorRef>
classes.description: Specialization of IListRefTagImpl for unboxed at::OptionalTensorRef.

classes.name: IListRefTagImpl<IListRefTag::Boxed, at::OptionalTensorRef>
classes.description: Specialization of IListRefTagImpl for boxed at::OptionalTensorRef with custom iterator_get.

classes.name: IListRefTagImpl<IListRefTag::Materialized, at::OptionalTensorRef>
classes.description: Specialization of IListRefTagImpl for materialized at::OptionalTensorRef.
